text:
omar: Heads upseeing a sudden uptick in fncall validation rejects on the canary slice around 10:03 UTC. Rejects ~6x baseline and a lot of traffic is falling through to the degen path. Console sample rate is near-zero so we can't inspect payloads.

jess: Is this only canary? Any customer-facing errors? :eyes:

omar: Only canary so far. No user reports, but routing churn and cost are spiking. Need payload samples and quick telemetry correlation.

ben: I rolled validators:v2.5.0-canary earlier with a stricter union->array coercion to catch malformed tool outputs. It was intended to be canary-only.

claire: Right, we flipped the implicit-coercion flag for unions. That should prevent ambiguous coercions but might be hitting some adapters that emit a single string for attachments.

omar: Example sanitized log line: [10:04:05Z] route=fncall-us-canary model=open-7b-q4 validator=validators:v2.5.0-canary outcome=REJECT reason="attachments expected array, got string"

jess: Console only exposes aggregate reject counts. Can we add a temporary panel breaking down rejects by validator_version, route, fallback_route, and sample_rate? Need correlation ASAP.

ben: I'll push validators:v2.5.1 that re-enables a soft-coercion toggle and also exposes a debug endpoint for backfill. Can we request a sample override: route=fncall-us-canary event=reject sample=100% duration=20m? Will flow through redact pipeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling validators:v2.5.1 -> canary (owner: @ben)

jess: Approve sample override for 20m. Enable redact and add console audit note. :white_check_mark:

product: product: We need to avoid billing shock from canary fallbacks. Proposal: implement a console-level "shadow-fallback" toggle for canaries that sends fallback to an observability-only path (no billing, no capacity consumption) but still surfaces metrics.

ben: Good idea. I'll add routing_tag=shadow-fallback for that path and emit metrics: validation.reject_mode={hard,soft,coerced} and routing.fallback_type={shadow,real}. Also will include a fallback_cost_estimate histogram so we can quantify impact.

claire: Dashboard inspector should show redacted payload + model reply + validator fingerprint string. That helps decide if adapter output or model behavior is the root cause.

omar: Short-term rule: default canary behavior -> shadow-fallback. If samples show adapter regression, revert adapter; if model output is deviating, revert validator strictness and open a targeted eval.

ben: Action plan: 1) enable 100% reject sampling for 20m and backfill 2) deploy validators:v2.5.1 with soft-coercion toggle 3) add dashboard timeseries + inspector and fallback_cost_estimate hist 4) ensure shadowed events are flagged non-billable in billing ingestion

alert-bot: alert-bot: created INC-2026-514 "canary-validate-rejects surge" (owner: eng-platform)

jess: Thanks. Ben/Omar, post two redacted examples here when the backfill completes. Claire, draft a short revert runbook (adapter vs validator) and attach to the incident. :thumbsup:
